title: CLA Task
text: Create CLA task that executes downstream function-call subsystem on CLA core, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Frequency at which function-call subsystem is triggered; {CLA task number}, {CLA task trigger source} sets the source of CLA task and {Wait until completion of task} sets the block C28x execution until CLA task. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Function-call signal to a function-call subsystem or function-call model scalar

params.name: CLA task number
params.values: CLA task number executed on CLA core 1 (default) | integer in [1, 8]

params.name: CLA task trigger source
params.values: Source of CLA task trigger Software (default) | peripheral interrupt

params.name: Wait until completion of task
params.values: Block C28x execution until CLA task is completed off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which function-call subsystem is triggered 0.2 (default) | -1 | scalar
